speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Threepence for the bench, Master Shakespeare. I am asking with the loaf in my hand, so the answer and the bread arrive together.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Threepence. Count it the first of the week.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: The first, and I am not offering a second with this dish. The loaf goes against the notch.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: It is short, mistress. I can see the gap from here.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Short by a finger. A finger is the width I will admit, and I will not make a sermon of a loaf.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then I will not preach one. The bread is the bread.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: I will take the short piece. A loom does not measure a finger.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: You were at a book again. Is there a plot I am owed, or is the page still shut?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: No new plot. The one you have already judged is the one I have.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then I am not owed a new one. The verdict I have can stand until you have a new story, and until my hands are empty.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: If there is no new speech, there is nothing for me to ask you to say again.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: There is no speech. Not in that book, and not for the table.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: The page on your board was face down this morning. I left it face down. Did it go?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It did not go. It has no day in it. It is not sent.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Is that the page I cannot read? I am not asking to be given it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The same page. You are not required to read it, Alse, and you could not if you were.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: A letter a house can use has a day in it. This one has none. I can count that without opening it.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: I will leave the letters to the people who write them. The herring is enough of a subject.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The herring is the meal. The road is not this dish, and the horse is not hired.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then do not hire it over my bread. The firing sixpence runs till Lady Day, and I am not collecting it over a dish.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am not asking you to. Nothing is paid today beyond this threepence.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: The pot survived the church, mistress. Seven was not long enough to boil it dry.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Seven, and we are home. I will take the threepence when you pass the stair, and I will not take a history with it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Threepence when I pass. The letter stays where it is.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: A quiet afternoon is a good afternoon. I am for the loom if the light holds.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Go, then. Master Shakespeare, the board stays as it is unless you take the page off it yourself.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It stays. Thank you, Mistress.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I will leave the water at the door, and I will not touch the page.
